what_changed: Moved from a general discount idea to a targeted return-visit pilot with a clear stop rule.
Identified that a simple visit-based reward was easier to staff than a complex tier system.
Compared referral and win-back options and selected a measurable referral test.
Converted rough customer counts and average ticket size into a break-even target.
Produced a staff script, KPI list, and 12-week launch plan from the same business description.
